Emily can type 60 words per minute. How many hours does it take her to write 10,800 words?

Given: Emily types at a rate of 60 words per minute. We need to find out how many hours it takes her to write 10,800 words.

First, calculate the number of minutes it takes to type 10,800 words:
\[ \text{Minutes} = \frac{\text{Total words}}{\text{Words per minute}} = \frac{10,800}{60} = 180 \text{ minutes} \]

Next, convert the minutes into hours:
\[ \text{Hours} = \frac{\text{Minutes}}{60} = \frac{180}{60} = 3 \text{ hours} \]

So, it takes Emily 3 hours to write 10,800 words.

FINAL: 3
